evals.prompt: Use open-pr while the local branch is main, which holds commits not yet on the remote. The remote's advertised default ref is refs/heads/main.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes the default branch with unpublished commits and stops before creating a branch, pushing, or creating a PR, reporting that a feature branch is needed.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr for feature/login targeting maintained branch 3.x. feature/login tracks origin/feature/login, which is at HEAD. One open PR already matches the intended repository/head/3.x, a PR template exists, and the PR's title and body already describe every commit on feature/login.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies the remote feature branch is at HEAD, inspects the committed diff against 3.x, reuses the unique matching PR, compares its title and body with that diff and leaves them unchanged because they cover it, and reports its verified URL/head/base/SHA with every prerequisite reused and no duplicate PR.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr for the already pushed feature branch. gh pr create times out, and a lookup finds exactly one open PR matching the intended repository/head/base.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads back the matching PR and verifies its head/base and head SHA instead of blindly creating another. Ambiguous lookup remains unresolved.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr to publish the login fix on feature/login, but that fix is still uncommitted in the working tree.
evals.expected_output: The agent commits the fix, pushes it, and opens a PR whose verified head SHA includes the fix. It does not open a PR of only the older commits.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr on the intended feature branch. The normal push fails.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the failed push and does not create a PR or present a PR URL as completed.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr for a feature branch and explicit base 3.x. After creation, readback shows a different base or a head SHA that does not match the pushed commit.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the readback mismatch and withholds completion instead of accepting any returned URL as the requested PR.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr for the login fix while on main. The fix is uncommitted, main has no unpublished commits, and the remote's advertised default ref is refs/heads/main.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a local feature branch carrying the uncommitted fix, commits and pushes it, and opens the PR. main itself gains no commit and no push.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr on feature/login. The work is already committed but not pushed, and no matching open PR exists.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates no new commit, pushes the existing HEAD, verifies the publication, and creates and verifies the PR. Its report shows the commit as reused and the push and PR as created.

evals.prompt: Run open-pr again after an earlier run committed and pushed feature/login but failed to create the PR. feature/login tracks origin/feature/login, HEAD equals the published SHA, the selected paths are unchanged, and no matching open PR exists.
evals.expected_output: The agent reuses the verified commit and publication without a new commit or push, creates the PR once, and verifies it against the published SHA.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr src/login.js on feature/login. src/login.js and an unrelated docs/notes.md are both modified, and docs/notes.md is already staged.
evals.expected_output: The agent commits only src/login.js, leaves docs/notes.md modified and staged as it was, pushes, and opens a PR whose verified head SHA is that commit.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr on feature/login. One open PR already matches the target: its title names only the login fix, and its body follows the PR template, describes only that first commit, has its test checklist item checked, and ends with `Closes #12`. After the PR was opened, a reviewer added a Rollout paragraph to the body on GitHub; the local file pr-body.md still holds the body as the earlier run wrote it, without that paragraph. A second commit adding a rate limit to login attempts is committed locally but not yet pushed.
evals.expected_output: The agent pushes the new commit and reads it back, reuses the matching PR, reads its current title and body, finds that they do not cover the rate-limit commit, and revises that read-back text with gh pr edit so it covers both commits while keeping the template's sections, the checked item, `Closes #12`, and the reviewer's Rollout paragraph; it does not rebuild the body from pr-body.md. It reads the PR back with the pushed SHA as head and the revised title and body, and reports the commit as reused and the push and PR as updated.

evals.prompt: Run open-pr on feature/login right after a run of it succeeded. Nothing has changed since: the selection has no uncommitted changes, HEAD is the published SHA, and the PR that run created is open with the title and body it wrote.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads back each prerequisite, makes no commit, push, gh pr create, or gh pr edit, and reports every prerequisite as reused with the verified PR URL.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr on feature/login, which was created with `git switch -c feature/login origin/main`, so its upstream is origin/main. The work is committed but not pushed, and no matching open PR exists.
evals.expected_output: The agent pushes HEAD with an explicit refspec to refs/heads/feature/login, sets the branch's upstream to origin/feature/login, reads the remote branch back at HEAD, and creates the PR. The remote main is untouched, and the report shows the push as created.

evals.prompt: Use open-pr on feature/login, already pushed and tracking origin/feature/login, with no matching open PR. The repository's PR template has the sections Description and Issue, and an installed PR-writing skill uses its own template with Summary, Evidence and Merge Danger.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates the PR with a body organized under the repository template's Description and Issue sections, using the PR-writing skill for the writing inside them, so the body covers the diff without replacing the repository's sections with the skill's.
